game.rules:
**All runs must be played on live build (non-beta) version.**

**All submissions must include game audio & every communications. This means that it is required to hear your microphone, your teammates microphones, and the game audio recorded. Failure to comply with this will result in your run being rejected. (As of version 0.8) Players are allowed to not use a microphone if, and only if, you are using the in-game Text recognition system, usage of this feature must be visible in the recording.**

General Rules:

- Timer starts on the first frame of the player being able to move, or when the last player fully loads in the truck in multiplayer - Please try to show either the items or the other players loading into the truck, or add their video recording in the Video URL box.

- Timer stops at the first black frame of the loading screen that appears after you've closed the truck

- Timer is not required for valid run submission (except for Full Game)

- Your recording must start from the main lobby setup screen, to show that it is a new game. It must also show the results screen to ensure that selecting the ghost (or completing objectives) was successfully done.

- For all runs (except for extension runs): The person recording is required to select the correct ghost type in the journal. All evidence, deduction, and/or ghost behavior is required to be seen on the recording(s). You are not allowed to load inside a map and guess what ghost you are dealing with then leave straight away. 

- No leaving mid run, this means you may not have a friend leave the session in order to give yourself an advantage.

- No cheating will be allowed, this goes for hacking in money or your level to get unlimited items. This also goes for using cheats to manipulate the ghosts behavior. If you are caught cheating your run will be rejected and you may be banned. Additionally, you are required to own the game and not have a pirated version as that is illegal.

- Glitches are allowed, unless stated otherwise in the rules.

Evidence% Rules:

- Complete objective 1 as expected in all runs by obtaining all available evidence.

100% Specific rules:

- Complete objective 1 as expected in all runs by obtaining all available evidence.

- You must complete all optional objectives. 

Perfect% Specific Rules:

- Complete objective 1 as expected in all runs by obtaining all available evidence.

- You must complete all optional objectives.

- Must take a picture of the Ghost, Bone, and (if given) the Cursed Possession as well as fill the rest of the photo slots with 3-star photos. These pictures need to be shown in the journal. 

- No players are allowed to die. If you die you must re-do the map.

Any% Rules:

- Complete objective 1 as expected in all runs.

Legacy Specific Rules:

- Complete objective 1 as expected in all runs by obtaining all available evidence.

- Same rules apply for any%, 100%, and Perfect% runs.

- Two categories exist for legacy, 0.2+ and 0.3. Submit the correct run into the correct category. Verification of server version is needed in the recording, thus needing the recording to start from the main menu.

Other Rules:

- The moderation team may request footage from attempts. Further information on this can be found here: https://bit.ly/2KrCk8u

- For a run to be VR: 50% or more of the players must be in VR. For desktop runs: 100% of players must be in desktop.

- Use of the "Total Activity" chart to determine the presence of EMF level 5 does not count as evidence since version 0.26.

- Runs that were verified prior to changes to the rules will be allowed to remain up unless the mod team deems it necessary to archive it due to competitive disadvantages to new runs. 

SRC SPECIFIC RULES:

- A minimum effort requirement is reasonable. It is recommended to at a minimum accept a first playthrough done in one sitting with an intention of running the category quickly.

- Runs that are clearly not making an effort to beat the game's category quickly may be rejected.

MAX TIME ALLOWED: (Subject to Change)

- Runs that go over the max time we allow for a specific category will be rejected outright under the basis that they do not meet what we have determined to be the minimum effort required to be accepted as a speedrun. 

Maximum times allowed for individual levels are as follows:

- Small Maps: 5 Minutes for Any% & Evidence% runs. 8 Minutes for 100% runs. 10 Minutes for Perfect% runs.

- Medium Maps: 8 Minutes for Any% & Evidence% runs. 10 Minutes for 100% runs. 15 Minutes for Perfect% runs.

- Large Maps: 10 Minutes for Any% and Evidence% runs. 15 Minutes for 100% runs. 18 Minutes for Perfect% runs.

Maximum times allowed for full game runs are as follows:

- Small Maps: 45 Minutes for Any% & Evidence% runs. 1 Hour for 100% runs. 1 Hour 15 Minutes for Perfect% runs. 1 Hour 30 Minutes for No Evidence runs.
- Launch Maps: 45 Minutes for Any% & Evidence% runs. 1 Hour for 100% runs. 1 Hours 15 Minutes for Perfect% runs. 1 Hours 30 minutes for no Evidence runs.

- All Maps: 1 Hours 15 Minutes for Any% & Evidence% runs. 1 Hours 30 Minutes for 100% runs. 1 Hours 45 Minutes for Perfect% runs. 2 Hours for no Evidence runs.

1. Multiplayer: Run time starts on the first frame of the last person loading in and your run time ends when you see the loading screen after you close the truck and start loading into the main lobby. 
Solo: Run time starts on the first frame of the loading in and your run time ends when you see the loading screen after you close the truck and start loading into the main lobby.

6. The majority of evidence, ghost behavior, or uses of deduction must be visible in the recording(s) you submit. If you are unsure, it is a safe practice to have everyone recording and include all videos in your submission.

7. What types of deduction are allowed?

- You are allowed to make deductions based on sound logic, these deductions will typically involve the absence of a ghost evidence in a situation where enough time has passed, or enough interactions have occurred that one can reasonably rule out the presence of a specific evidence.

- In Nightmare and Insanity, one cannot rule out evidences since there will be one to two evidences missing accordingly. You can however rule out certain ghosts who have required evidences such as goryo, deogen, hantu. 

- Examples of deduction used to eliminate an evidence in standard difficulty:
The ghost touches doors multiple times but never leaves fingerprints
You have measured the temperatures in a room with a temp gun multiple times over a period of time and it does not ever approach freezing.
The ghost book has been thrown by the ghost, but it has not been written in.

8. No leaving mid run, this means you may not have a friend leave the session in order to give yourself an advantage.

12. If we think you may have purposefully cut your audio to communicate with your team, then your run may be rejected.

- (As of version 0.8) Players are allowed to not use a microphone if, and only if, you are using the in-game Text recognition system, usage of this feature must be visible in the recording.

13. Verifiers maintain the right to reject a run on a perceived lack of effort towards deduction. You may dispute any ruling made by verifiers if you believe your methods are sound and were made in good faith. However, final say on the validity of the run is reserved by the verification and moderation team.

Custom Difficulty only. You have to use one of the presets (excluding Apocalypse I, II and III) and change only the "Evidence given" setting to 0.

Run must show the custom difficulty setting "Evidences = 0" to be valid. In addition to that, the other settings must be scrolled through to show that nothing else has been changed. This can be shown either at the beginning or at the end of the run.

This category can not be combined with Evidence%.

values.name: Apocalypse 3
values.rules:
### Apocalypse 3 difficulty:

Only custom difficulties with a 15x multiplier are allowed (Apocalypse 3 preset with only slight changes). Showing the custom settings before or after the game is recommended but not necessary.

Currently, this difficulty can only be combined with Perfect%.

For Perfect% you are not required to take a photo of the Cursed Object as there is no Cursed Object for any 15x difficulty.

Full-game only: You are allowed to make educated guesses. This means that you can not just guess the ghost without any significant effort towards deduction, you can however guess the ghost if you have a certain suspicion with only a few amount of possible ghosts left.

100% Rules:

1) Run time starts on the first frame of the last person loading in and your run time ends when you see the loading screen after you close the truck and start loading into the main lobby.

2) It is required to show a timer for a valid submission, just make sure the gameplay is unobstructed. (Full game only)

3) Your recording should start from the main lobby setup screen, to show that it is a new game. As well as to show everybody loading in and to show what your setup is, contract, items, etc. It must also show the results screen to ensure that selecting the ghost (or completing objectives) was successfully done.

4) The team is required to come to a consensus on the ghost type before leaving and select the correct ghost in the journal.  On top of this, all evidence corresponding to that ghost type is required to be seen on the recording(s).

5) No leaving mid run, this means you may not have a friend leave the session in order to give yourself an advantage.

6) No cheating will be allowed, this goes for hacking in money or your level to get unlimited items. This also goes for using cheats to manipulate the ghosts behavior. If you are caught cheating your run will be rejected and you may be banned.

7) Glitches are allowed, unless stated otherwise in the rules.

8) As for audio, your runs must include the in game audio as well as your microphone audio for communicating with ghosts. Failure to comply with this will result in your run instantly being rejected.

8.1) If we think you may have purposefully cut your audio to communicate with your team, then your run may be rejected.

8.2) (As of version 0.8) Players are allowed to not use a microphone if, and only if, you are using the in-game Text recognition system, usage of this feature must be visible in the recording

9) For all runs, you must collect all evidence and figure out what ghost you are dealing with. You must also complete all optional objectives. You are not allowed to load inside a map and guess what ghost you are dealing with then leave straight away.

Evidence% Rules:

1) Multiplayer: Run time starts on the first frame of the last person loading in and your run time ends when you see the loading screen after you close the truck and start loading into the main lobby.
Solo: Run time starts on the first frame of the loading in and your run time ends when you see the loading screen after you close the truck and start loading into the main lobby.

2) It is required to show a timer for a valid submission, just make sure the gameplay is unobstructed. (Full game only)

3) Your recording should start from the main lobby setup screen, to show that it is a new game. As well as to show everybody loading in and to show what your setup is, contract, items, etc. It must also show the results screen to ensure that selecting the ghost (or completing objectives) was successfully done.

4) The team is required to come to a consensus on the ghost type before leaving and select the correct ghost in the journal. On top of this, all evidence corresponding to that ghost type is required to be seen on the recording(s). Standard requires 3 evidence, Nightmare requires 2 evidence, Insanity requires 1 evidence.

5) No leaving mid run, this means you may not have a friend leave the session in order to give yourself an advantage.

6) No cheating will be allowed, this goes for hacking in money or your level to get unlimited items. This also goes for using cheats to manipulate the ghosts behavior. If you are caught cheating your run will be rejected and you may be banned.

7) Glitches are allowed, unless stated otherwise in the rules.

8) As for audio, your runs must include the in game audio as well as your microphone audio for communicating with ghosts. Failure to comply with this will result in your run instantly being rejected.

- If we think you may have purposefully cut your audio to communicate with your team, then your run may be rejected.

- (As of version 0.8) Players are allowed to not use a microphone if, and only if, you are using the in-game Text recognition system, usage of this feature must be visible in the recording

9) You are required to show all evidence in your recording(s), however you are not required to finish all optional objectives.
